title: Public Utilities Code, Division 1, Part 1 (Public Utilities Act)
source_id: Cal. Pub. Util. Code §§ 201-2120 (rates §§ 451-468, 727-758; service termination for nonpayment §§ 779-779.1 in Ch 4 Art 3)
verified_how: Fetched the PUC Div 1 Part 1 expanded branch: 'PART 1. PUBLIC UTILITIES ACT 201-2120', Ch 4 Art 2 Rates 727-758, Art 3 761-788. §201 says 'This part may be cited as the Public Utilities Act.' §779.1 was amended by Stats. 2019, Ch. 497.
notes: Covers CPUC-regulated utilities. Detailed billing rules sit in CPUC tariffs and decisions. Municipal utilities are governed elsewhere. Tenant water submetering is Civ. Code §§1954.201-1954.219.
